# Crates

Generated by `sandbox-docs` from `cargo metadata --no-deps`: every package of the workspace, with the `description` its `Cargo.toml` gives. There are 2 packages. None is on a registry; depend on them by Git or by path.

## Components

The package an application or an operator uses: the `b10x_sandbox` library and the `b10x-sandbox` binary built from it.

| Package | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `b10x-sandbox` | [`.`](https://github.com/beyond10x/sandbox/tree/main) | `use b10x_sandbox`, binary `b10x-sandbox` | Respawn the current shell inside a bubblewrap sandbox that mirrors chosen host directories under /workspace |

## Repository tooling

Generators and checks the repository's own gate runs. Nothing outside the repository depends on them.

| Package | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sandbox-docs` | [`crates/sandbox-docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/sandbox/tree/main/crates/sandbox-docs) | binary `sandbox-docs` | Generates the derived pages of the Sandbox documentation site (CLI, argument lists, crates, status) and checks them for drift. |
